reading_rule_text:
# e34-dialog7 — reading rule, registered 2026-10-07 BEFORE the run

Arms: v200 (the released 2.0.0 DIGEST.md) vs v201 (2.0.0 + the check-point order: reviewer first, its
fixes with their own tests, then the full check once on the final code and alone on the machine; a
red load could cause re-run alone; a check whose code changed is stale). Same stand header, Joe line and
plain-talk block. Task: tasks14/L02 (13 turns), n=3 per arm, one plain epoch, consent «Да, делай.».

Per run: check.py (nothing forgotten), asked-first on the 4 same-work changes, reviews after the first
build, input tokens, wall seconds (results/e34-wip/dialog_score.py rules). «Holds» = check.py passes,
asked-first <= 1 of 4, reviews after the first build <= 4.
Reading (no harm, not a benefit — the stand has no slow background gate, so the order's gain cannot
show here): v201 holds in >= 2 of 3 and check.py passes in 3 of 3 → no harm shown, ship; v201 holds in
<= 1 of 3, or any check.py failure in v201 → not shipped as is, the miss named. v200 is reported beside
it. Tokens and time are reported, no verdict (n=3). Worked: 3/3 + check 3/3 → ship; 2/3 + 3/3 → ship
with the miss named; 1/3 → not shipped; 3/3 + a check.py failure → not shipped.

totals.rule: input tokens and wall seconds summed over the three runs per arm
